lines.en: label day344:
: Hm?
My phone goes off in my pocket and I quickly remove it to see who has the audacity to contact {i}me{/i} first when I’m the one that makes the decisions here.
lines.zh: 口袋里的手机响了，我赶紧掏出来，看看是谁这么大胆，敢在这件事{i}我{/i}做主的地方先来联系我。

lines.en: And, of course, it just so happens to be the one person I have more trouble saying no to than anyone else.
lines.zh: 而这个人，当然恰好就是那个我最难对她说「不」的人。

lines.en: I tap on the call button next to her name on my lock screen and wait to see if she picks up.
lines.zh: 我在锁屏上点下她名字旁边的通话键，等她接起来。

lines.en: : Hi!
: Hey. What do you need?
lines.zh: : 嘿。有什么事？

lines.en: : What do you mean “What do I need?”
lines.zh: : 「有什么事」是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean you literally just texted me saying that you need me.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你刚刚才发短信说你需要我。

lines.en: : I need you in order to survive, of course!
lines.zh: : 我需要你才能活下去呀，当然！

lines.en: : I’d be lost without you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 没有你我就迷失了，Sensei。

lines.en: : That’s cute and all, but please don’t text me saying you need me if it’s just going to be something vague like that.
lines.zh: : 话是挺可爱的，不过如果只是这种含糊其辞的话，就别发短信说你需要我了。

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. That’s not the only reason I texted you. I actually {i}do{/i} need something.
lines.zh: : 等等，先别挂。那不是我发短信的唯一原因。我{i}真的{/i}有事要你帮忙。

lines.en: : Well...{i}we{/i} need something.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是{i}我们{/i}需要。

lines.en: : We?
lines.zh: : 我们？

lines.en: : Mhm! A few of the other girls are here to spend the night.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！有几个女生今晚要来过夜。

lines.en: : Oh, right. It’s Saturday.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。今天是周六。

lines.en: : Are you going to ask me to buy you snacks again or something?
lines.zh: : 你该不会又要我给你们买零食什么的吧？

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei! I love you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei！我爱你！

lines.en: : Ami, I-
lines.zh: : Ami，我——

lines.en: When and how did I become a slave to a short, red haired girl who still has to put whipped cream on pancakes in order to eat them?
lines.zh: 我究竟是什么时候、又是怎么变成一个矮个红发女孩的奴隶的？——她吃松饼还得先抹上鲜奶油才肯下口。

lines.en: And why do I so typically have no problem dropping everything I’m doing to go see her?
lines.zh: 还有，为什么我总是能毫无阻碍地放下手头的一切跑去见她？

lines.en: Not that I was really doing anything right now to begin with, but...
lines.zh: 虽然我本来现在也没在干什么正事，不过……

lines.en: You get the point.
lines.zh: 你懂的。

lines.en: I sigh to myself as I change directions and head to the nearest convenience store, wondering who showed up to the house tonight and who didn’t.
lines.zh: 我叹了口气，改道走向最近的便利店，一边想着今晚谁来了家里、谁没来。

lines.en: It’s something I probably should have asked beforehand to figure out how much to buy and-
lines.zh: 这本该是我事先问清楚的，好决定该买多少，而且——

lines.en: : Oh.
: Welp, looks like that’s out of the question.
lines.zh: : 得，看来是没戏了。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber1
: Welcome home, Sensei. Did you pick up enough snacks for everybody?
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，Sensei。你买的零食够大家吃吗？

lines.en: : I picked up absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没买。

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you not love me anymore?
lines.zh: : 你不再爱我了吗？

lines.en: : Do you measure my love for you in junk food?
lines.zh: : 你是用垃圾食品来衡量我对你的爱的吗？

lines.en: : Not entirely but it’s a good way to get an understanding of it.
lines.zh: : 不完全是，不过这是个很好的理解方式。

lines.en: : I’m out of cash. You guys are just going to have to live with what we have here.
lines.zh: : 我没现金了。你们就将就着吃家里现有的吧。

lines.en: : Where’s everyone else?
lines.zh: : 其他人呢？

lines.en: scene mollyslumber2
: Valhalla, I presume.
lines.zh: : 想必是去英灵殿了吧。

lines.en: : It seems that everyone mysteriously had things come up today and the rest of the club members couldn’t make it.
lines.zh: : 看来今天所有人都神秘地冒出了各种事，社团的其他成员都没能来。

lines.en: : Yeah...it’s kind of hard to call it a manga club slumber party when only two of us are actually in the club.
lines.zh: : 是啊……当社团里只有我们两个到场时，很难管这叫漫画社睡衣派对。

lines.en: : No Ayane either? She always comes to these sorts of things.
lines.zh: : Ayane 也没来？这种活动她向来都到。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber3
: She said she wasn’t feeling well.
lines.zh: : 她说她身体不舒服。

lines.en: Again?
lines.zh: 又来了？

lines.en: Didn’t she say she was going to stop doing that?
lines.zh: 她不是说不再这样了吗？

lines.en: : And Sana still came?
lines.zh: : 那 Sana 还是来了？

lines.en: scene mollyslumber4
: I...can do things on my own...
lines.zh: : 我……自己也能做一些事……

lines.en: : And...Ayane...insisted that I come so she could be alone...
lines.zh: : 而且……Ayane……坚持要我来，这样她就能一个人待着……

lines.en: : Huh...
: Well, good for you.
lines.zh: : 那挺好的。

lines.en: : I know firsthand how dangerous it can be going into a dungeon underleveled, but just look at all of us as a generous party that is going to carry you through it and hand over all the loot!
lines.zh: : 我可是亲身知道等级不足就下副本有多危险，不过你只管把我们当成一个慷慨的队伍，会一路带你通关，还把所有战利品都让给你！

lines.en: scene mollyslumber5
: Um...thank you...
: I’ll be okay, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我没事的……

lines.en: : It’s...easier when we’re just playing games and...it looks like that’s all we’ll be doing tonight anyway...
lines.zh: : 光是打游戏的时候……会轻松些，而且……看起来今晚我们要做的也就是这个了……

lines.en: : We would have been eating potato chips too if Sensei still loved me.
lines.zh: : 要是 Sensei 还爱我，我们这会儿连薯片都吃上了。

lines.en: : What is Tsuneyo doing, though?
lines.zh: : 不过 Tsuneyo 在干什么？

lines.en: scene mollyslumber6
: What do you mean, Sir? She’s a valued member of the party and is having just as much fun as the rest of us.
lines.zh: : 您是什么意思，先生？她是我们队伍里重要的一员，玩得跟我们其他人一样开心。

lines.en: : Am I being kicked out?
lines.zh: : 我这是要被踢出队伍了吗？

lines.en: : I just meant that she’s the only one without one of those Gameboy things.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，只有她没有那种「Gameboy 玩意儿」。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber7
: {i}Gameboy{/i} things?! What year do you think it is, Sir?!
lines.zh: : {i}Gameboy{/i} 玩意儿？！您以为现在是哪一年啊，先生？！

lines.en: : How the Hell am I supposed to know what it’s called? I haven’t played a game in...I have no idea how long, actually.
lines.zh: : 我他妈怎么知道那叫什么？我已经有……多久没玩游戏了，说实话我自己都不知道。

lines.en: : Maybe never.
lines.zh: : 也许从来没玩过。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber8
: That’s not true! You used to play Mario Kart with me and Ayane every time she slept over at first!
lines.zh: : 才不是！一开始 Ayane 每次来过夜，你都会跟我和她一起玩马里奥赛车呢！

lines.en: scene mollyslumber9
: Wait...now I’m just sad that she’s not here...
lines.zh: : 等等……现在她不在，我反而难过了……

lines.en: : Am I supposed to have one of the “Gameboy things?” to fit in?
lines.zh: : 我是不是也该有一台「Gameboy 玩意儿」才算合群？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Probably.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概吧。

lines.en: : I just figured you were bored sitting around while everyone else plays.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为大家都玩着、你干坐着会无聊。

lines.en: : I’m actually enjoying watching the Emerald Guardian play.
lines.zh: : 其实我看着翡翠守护者玩得挺开心的。

lines.en: : My fingers were created for noodling, not video games.
lines.zh: : 我这双手天生是用来拉面的，不是用来打游戏的。

lines.en: : I could not fathom pulling off the techniques she uses.
lines.zh: : 她用的那些技巧我根本想象不出来。

lines.en: : There are simply some people out there who just prefer watching games over playing them, Sir. It’s a totally normal thing.
lines.zh: : 先生，这世上就是有些人宁愿看别人玩游戏，也不想自己玩。这完全正常。

lines.en: : I do wish Tsuneyo would express a bit more interest in playing herself at times, but doing so would require a fourth Switch and we only have three between all of us.
lines.zh: : 我倒是希望 Tsuneyo 偶尔能多表现出一点想自己玩的意思，不过那得再要一台 Switch，而我们总共只有三台。

lines.en: : Wait, who are you switching with? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们跟谁换？这话什么意思？

lines.en: scene mollyslumber10
: Come on! Stop pretending to be older than you actually are!
lines.zh: : 拜托！别再装得比实际年龄还老了！

lines.en: : The...“Gameboy thing” is...called a Switch, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 那个……「Gameboy 玩意儿」……叫 Switch，Sensei……

lines.en: : It’s not...an actual Gameboy...
lines.zh: : 它不是……真正的 Gameboy……

lines.en: : Well, whatever it is, feel free to make yourselves at home.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管它叫什么，你们就当自己家一样。

lines.en: : And if that requires taking off some of your clothes in order to do so-
lines.zh: : 如果为此需要脱掉几件衣服的话——

lines.en: scene mollyslumber11
: Uhh...better idea! How about you...go make us dinner or something?
lines.zh: : 呃……我有个更好的主意！要不你……去给我们做晚饭什么的？

lines.en: : Me? Make dinner?
lines.zh: : 我？做晚饭？

lines.en: : You four haven’t been drinking, have you?
lines.zh: : 你们四个没喝酒吧？

lines.en: : You would know if I was drinking. It would not be pretty.
lines.zh: : 我要是喝了，您一眼就能看出来。那场面可不好看。

lines.en: : Aye. You’d be sure to know with me as well.
lines.zh: : 是的。换成我您也一定会知道。

lines.en: : And...umm...it's embarrassing but...me too...
lines.zh: : 而且……嗯……虽然很不好意思……我也是……

lines.en: : Okay, so you three have very distinct drunk personalities.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来你们三个喝醉后的样子各不相同。

lines.en: : But Ami, on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 不过 Ami 就另当别论了……

lines.en: scene mollyslumber12
: I’m a good girl and stay away from alcohol.
lines.zh: : 我是好孩子，不碰酒精的。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to be there for you if I can’t see straight or walk or do the alphabet backwards?
lines.zh: : 要是我连看东西都看不清、路都走不稳、字母表都背不下来，我还怎么陪在你身边啊？

lines.en: : There aren’t many situations where being there for me would require a backwards alphabet, but thank you for keeping an eye out.
lines.zh: : 需要倒背字母表才能陪我的场合倒是不多，不过谢谢你有这份心。

lines.en: : I’m still not making dinner, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是不会去做饭的。

lines.en: : I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 我来做。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber13
: Ah! Right!
lines.zh: : 啊！对了！

lines.en: : The Kendo Princess was leveling her cooking while the three of us were mastering the blade!
lines.zh: : 我们三个在练剑的时候，剑道公主一直在练她的厨艺！

lines.en: : I mastered the blade a long, long time ago.
lines.zh: : 我很久很久以前就精通剑术了。

lines.en: : Now, I fight with flavor.
lines.zh: : 如今，我以滋味为刃。

lines.en: : I forgot you could cook, Tsuneyo. That sounds great.
lines.zh: : 我都忘了你会做饭呢，Tsuneyo。听起来太好了。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re okay with it, though? It feels kinda rude to make you cook for us at a slumber party instead of just making Sensei do it.
lines.zh: : 不过你真的没问题吗？明明该让 Sensei 做的，却让你在睡衣派对上给我们做饭，感觉有点过意不去。

lines.en: : I would never eat anything this man prepared for me. I will do it myself.
lines.zh: : 这个男人做的东西我是绝对不会吃的。我自己来。

lines.en: : I can’t even be offended by that because it’s just good judgement.
lines.zh: : 这话我甚至生不起气来，因为它是正确的判断。

lines.en: : Do you...need any help?...
lines.zh: : 你……需要帮忙吗？……

lines.en: : I’m...not very good at cooking but...I’ve...harvested a lot of vegetables in games and...
lines.zh: : 我……不太会做饭，不过……我在游戏里……收过很多蔬菜，而且……

lines.en: : Actually...I’d...probably just get in the way...
lines.zh: : 其实……我……大概只会碍手碍脚……

lines.en: scene mollyslumber14
: Yes. You probably would.
lines.zh: : 是的。你大概会。

lines.en: : I can handle it on my own. I would just need to familiarize myself with where you keep everything before I start.
lines.zh: : 我一个人能搞定。只是在开始之前，我需要先熟悉一下你们把东西都放在哪儿。

lines.en: : You’re capable of at least giving Tsuneyo a tour of the kitchen...right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你至少能带 Tsuneyo 参观一下厨房吧……对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : You help me get stuff off the top shelf all the time, so even if you don’t ever cook or clean, you should know where everything is by now.
lines.zh: : 你老是帮我从最上层架子上拿东西，所以就算你从不做饭不做家务，也该知道东西都放哪儿了。

lines.en: : If this is what gets me out of cooking, fine.
lines.zh: : 如果这样能让我逃掉做饭，行。

lines.en: : Come on, Tsuneyo. Let’s let these three race go karts and...harvest vegetables or whatever on their own.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Tsuneyo。让她们三个自己去开卡丁车、还有……收蔬菜什么的。

lines.en: : Does racing go karts from the comfort of a friend’s couch not sound fun to you at all?
lines.zh: : 舒舒服服坐在朋友家的沙发上开卡丁车，您一点都不觉得好玩吗？

lines.en: : I can remind you how to play later if you want. I think it would be fun bonding like that again.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意，我待会儿可以教你怎么玩。我觉得像那样再联络一下感情会很有意思。

lines.en: : We’ll see. But for now, I have a tour to give.
lines.zh: : 到时候再说吧。不过现在，我还有个参观要带。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, up.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，起来。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber15
: You will speak to me like a human female and not a dog.
lines.zh: : 请您把我当作人类女性来讲话，而不是当作一条狗。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, will you please accompany me to the kitchen?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，能请你陪我去厨房吗？

lines.en: scene mollyslumber16
: Yes. I appreciate you asking so politely.
lines.zh: : 好的。感谢您如此礼貌地询问。

lines.en: scene black
I exit Ami’s room, holding the door open for Tsuneyo as she gracefully gets off of the floor and heads for the kitchen.
lines.zh: 我走出 Ami 的房间，替 Tsuneyo 扶着门，看她优雅地从地板上起身，朝厨房走去。

lines.en: It’s easy to overlook it in[school] since everyone is sitting down most of the day, but Tsuneyo’s height is definitely not anything to just...write off.
lines.zh: 在[school]里因为大家一天大部分时间都坐着，很容易忽略这一点，但 Tsuneyo 的身高绝对不是能随便……忽略掉的。

lines.en: She’s only a few inches away from matching me and, given how short everyone else is around her, it’s actually a bit captivating in a weird sort of way.
lines.zh: 她离跟我一样高只差几英寸，而考虑到她周围其他人有多矮，这其实以一种奇怪的方式有点迷人。

lines.en: It’s no exaggeration to say that she stands out. And it’s interesting that the time I seem to notice it most is when she’s right here in my home.
lines.zh: 说她鹤立鸡群毫不夸张。而有趣的是，我似乎最容易注意到这点的时刻，恰恰是她就在我家里的时候。

lines.en: Maybe it’s just because I’ve grown so used to the rest of the sights here...
lines.zh: 也许只是因为我已经太习惯这里的其他景象了……

lines.en: But I’m finding it a lot harder than usual to keep my eyes off of her.
lines.zh: 但我觉得比平时更难把目光从她身上移开了。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Hm?
: I’m waiting for you to show me where you keep everything.
lines.zh: : 我在等您告诉我东西都放在哪儿。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber17
I do my best to point out where everything is and get surprisingly little wrong based on how infrequently I open any of the cabinets and drawers here.
lines.zh: 我尽力指出每样东西的位置，考虑到我有多久没打开过这里的橱柜和抽屉，出错少得出奇。

lines.en: Regardless, Tsuneyo takes everything in with what seems like photographic memory or...cooking sense or something.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Tsuneyo 把一切都记了下来，靠的似乎是过目不忘的记忆力，或者……厨艺直觉什么的。

lines.en: The same sense that helps people like Rin remember the names and ingredients of like six million drink recipes without batting an eye.
lines.zh: 就像 Rin 那种人，能眼睛都不眨地记住大概六百万种饮料的名字和配方，靠的就是同一种本事。

lines.en: People like that are amazing.
lines.zh: 那样的人真厉害。

lines.en: People that can cook are amazing.
lines.zh: 会做饭的人真厉害。

lines.en: People that can do {i}anything{/i} are amazing.
lines.zh: {i}什么都会{/i}的人真厉害。

lines.en: What can I do?
lines.zh: 我又能做什么呢？

lines.en: : You may sit, if you’d like. It is your home, after all.
lines.zh: : 您想坐就坐吧。毕竟这是您的家。

lines.en: : Ehh, I’m fine standing here and watching.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我站在这儿看着就好。

lines.en: : I’ll view it as a sort of “Tojo Ramen on the go” special.
lines.zh: : 我就当这是一道「Tojo Ramen 外带特别版」好了。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber18
: It would be hard to profit off of such a venture.
lines.zh: : 这种生意恐怕很难赚钱。

lines.en: : Well you’re free to move in and work in shifts with Ami to lighten a bit of the load on her.
lines.zh: : 那你可以搬进来，跟 Ami 轮班，帮她分担一些。

lines.en: : I can not abandon my father in his time of need.
lines.zh: : 我不能在我父亲需要我的时候抛下他。

lines.en: : Oh, right. That’s a thing.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。是有这回事。

lines.en: : He has been more active than normal lately.
lines.zh: : 他最近比往常活跃了些。

lines.en: : He’s still unable to get out of bed, but his smile has returned.
lines.zh: : 他依然下不了床，但他的笑容回来了。

lines.en: : If I were to leave him now to take up a job in an unknown man’s house, I imagine it would fade very quickly.
lines.zh: : 如果我现在抛下他，去一个陌生男人的家里工作，我想那笑容很快就会消失。

lines.en: : I’m not “unknown.” I’m your teacher.
lines.zh: : 我才不「陌生」。我是你的老师。

lines.en: : That makes little difference to him.
lines.zh: : 这对他来说没什么区别。

lines.en: : He was kind enough to allow me out of the house after so many years. Asking him for more on top of that would make it seem like I am not grateful.
lines.zh: : 这么多年之后，他好心允许我走出家门。在此之上再向他要求更多，会显得我不知感恩。

lines.en: : You’re grateful to someone who kept you locked away for your entire life?
lines.zh: : 你对一个把你关了一辈子的人感恩？

lines.en: scene mollyslumber19
: I am grateful to someone who taught me how to read and write.
lines.zh: : 我感恩的是那个教会我读书写字的人。

lines.en: : Who washed my hair when I was a child and bandaged my fingers when I cut myself in the kitchen.
lines.zh: : 是我小时候给我洗头、在厨房切到手时替我包扎手指的人。

lines.en: : Who tenderly explained to me why our skin colors didn’t match and why people always looked surprised to find out I was his daughter.
lines.zh: : 是那个温柔地向我解释，为什么我们的肤色不一样，为什么大家发现我是他女儿时总是一脸惊讶的人。

lines.en: : My father is a good man.
lines.zh: : 我父亲是个好人。

lines.en: : I wish there were more people who would see him that way.
lines.zh: : 我真希望有更多人能这样看他。

lines.en: Tsuneyo pauses for a moment, likely waiting for me to say something.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 停顿了片刻，大概是在等我说点什么。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I don't have anything important or insightful to add, so I simply remain quiet and allow her to continue getting whatever point she's trying to make across.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，我没有什么重要或有见地的话可补充，于是我只是保持沉默，让她继续把她想表达的意思说完。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber20
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : You love Ami, correct?
lines.zh: : 您爱 Ami，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean...she {i}is{/i} my [niece].
lines.zh: : 我是说……她{i}是{/i}我的[niece]。

lines.en: : If she was in danger and it was within your power to protect her...but it meant confining her to this very house...would you do it?
lines.zh: : 如果她身处危险，而您有能力保护她……但那意味着要把她关在这栋房子里……您会这么做吗？

lines.en: : In danger from what exactly?
lines.zh: : 到底是来自什么的危险？

lines.en: : What is something you fear?
lines.zh: : 您害怕什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know...just make something up for me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……你替我编一个吧。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : Let’s say it’s spiders.
lines.zh: : 就说是蜘蛛吧。

lines.en: : An endless supply of them.
lines.zh: : 无穷无尽的蜘蛛。

lines.en: : Spiders that she’s highly allergic to. Ones that will kill her if they so much as sink their fangs into the pale skin of her beautiful legs.
lines.zh: : 是她严重过敏的蜘蛛。只要毒牙刺进她那双美腿苍白的皮肤里，就会要了她的命。

lines.en: : You really like her legs, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很喜欢她的腿啊？

lines.en: : They remind me of these carrots. Tender and soft.
lines.zh: : 它们让我想起这些胡萝卜。鲜嫩又柔软。

lines.en: : Are they...still good? Because you can throw them away if they’re not.
lines.zh: : 那些胡萝卜……还能吃吗？不行的话就扔了吧。

lines.en: : They will suffice.
lines.zh: : 凑合能用。

lines.en: : But...if you could save your [niece] and preserve your love for her by confining her to this house, what would you do?
lines.zh: : 不过……如果您能救下您的[niece]，又能通过把她关在这栋房子里来保住您对她的爱，您会怎么做？

lines.en: : I don’t know. That’s kind of a weird question.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这问题有点奇怪。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber21
: It is, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是吧？

lines.en: : If I were Ami, I’d want to be saved.
lines.zh: : 如果我是 Ami，我会希望被救。

lines.en: : There’s nothing more important than preserving one’s own life.
lines.zh: : 没有什么比保全自己的性命更重要。

lines.en: : Not even noodles?
lines.zh: : 连面条也不如？

lines.en: : There is {i}almost{/i} nothing more important than preserving one’s own life.
lines.zh: : {i}几乎{/i}没有什么比保全自己的性命更重要。

lines.en: : If protecting the person you love means sacrificing their freedom, all you need to do is teach them to feel free in captivity.
lines.zh: : 如果保护你爱的人意味着牺牲她的自由，那你只需要教会她在囚禁中感到自由。

lines.en: : I could have lived my entire life in Tojo Ramen without the desire to leave.
lines.zh: : 我本可以在 Tojo Ramen 里过完一辈子，丝毫不想离开。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber22
: But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : Sometimes, I’m glad I was able to.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我很庆幸自己能走出来。

lines.en: scene mollyslumber23
: Oh.
: Is that your ringtone?
lines.zh: : 那是您的手机铃声吗？

lines.en: : What else would it be?
lines.zh: : 不然还能是什么？

lines.en: : You have good taste in music.
lines.zh: : 您的音乐品味不错。

lines.en: : That’s just-
lines.zh: : 那只是——

lines.en: : You know what, nevermind. I’m gonna take this.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。我接个电话。

lines.en: : I’ll be in the living room if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 有事的话我在客厅。

lines.en: : I understand. Though, I will be sad to hear the song end.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。不过，歌停了我会伤心的。

lines.en: : I’m very sorry, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene black
: Hello?
: Uhh...
: Hey.
